# Measure Joy

> Measure Joy (measurejoy.org) is an e-commerce store specializing in curated, tested Y2K-era digital cameras (roughly 1998–2008) and accessories. Every camera is professionally inspected with a 15-point test and ships with a compatible battery and a 90-day functionality warranty. The brand serves creators, photographers, and nostalgia lovers who want the authentic digital grain and aesthetic of early digital photography.

Measure Joy sells vintage compact digital cameras from brands like Canon (PowerShot), Sony (Cyber-shot), Nikon (Coolpix), Fujifilm (FinePix), Olympus, Kodak (EasyShare), Casio (Exilim), Panasonic (Lumix), Pentax (Optio), Samsung, and HP — plus accessories such as SD/xD/Memory Stick cards, camera cases, straps, tripods, batteries, screen protectors, and cleaning kits.

## Key Pages

- [Shop All Products](https://www.measurejoy.org/shop): Full catalog of Y2K digital cameras and accessories
- [Collections](https://www.measurejoy.org/collections): Curated camera collections by style and category
- [About](https://www.measurejoy.org/about): The Measure Joy story and mission
- [Journal](https://www.measurejoy.org/journal): Articles on Y2K cameras, digicam culture, and photography tips
- [FAQ](https://www.measurejoy.org/faq): Answers on shipping, returns, warranty, camera condition, and payment

## Policies

- [Shipping](https://www.measurejoy.org/shipping): US standard 3–5 business days ($9.99, free over $75); express 1–2 days ($19.99); ships to US, Canada, UK, and Australia
- [Returns & Warranty](https://www.measurejoy.org/returns): 14-day return window; 90-day functionality warranty on all cameras
- [Camera Repair](https://www.measurejoy.org/repair): Repair services for vintage digital cameras
- [Contact](https://www.measurejoy.org/contact): Customer support

## Facts

- Every camera passes a 15-point inspection (lens clarity, LCD, buttons, flash, image quality)
- A compatible battery is included with every camera
- Payments are processed securely via Stripe (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
- Condition grades: Excellent (minimal wear, fully functional), Good, Fair — described per listing
